notes: TRUTH.yaml status enum {PENDING, APPROVED, WITHDRAWN_APPROVAL} confirmed live — REJECTED is rejected by upstream with an explicit enum error. Response shape (bare array, approvalRequest wrapper, ISO 8601 durations, money in minor units) confirmed with APPROVED filter. Minor gap: TRUTH.yaml documents costAmount as type:number (correct) and billableAmount as type:integer — but live raw shows both as floating-point values (e.g. billableAmount: 885877.7777...). TRUTH marks billableAmount as integer which is slightly imprecise but not a demotion-level discrepancy for GET. The MCP tool normalises these into money_totals with proper decimal display.
